name: smartinno
summary: Message Bus infrastructure for multi-cloud systems with AES-256-GCM encryption, HMAC signing, sliding-window nonces, Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ), dynamic Redis Cluster uniform slotting, atomic numeric operations (HINCRBY/INCR), native deterministic O(1) set lookups, token-verified lock ownership release, strict Pydantic validation propagation, zero pre-publish write overhead, sub-millisecond Token Bucket rate limiting (§8.0), and W3C distributed tracing traceparent propagation (§7.0).
